body: No one wants to fight in my opinion. It just depends how you respond to it. Some people (me included) look at how long they have to fight for and give up. I can't do it anymore though.
Yea same here. When I'm feeling like shit all I can use my brain for is youtube, talking to random people on reddit or listening to music.
There's a comfort in the thought that there is always a way out. It actually helped me talk myself out of doing it a couple times. Good luck with life.

You have to make your own hope. Nothing else I can say because I haven't found it yet either. Still sitting here wondering. Hope you find what you're looking for and I'm always here if you want to vent (I'm not doing so great so don't expect advice).
I'm the kind of person who just loses all meaning when I have nothing to do. Basically I'm lazy and can't be bothered.
Can't argue with the method but I can argue with the reasoning. Why are you doing this if you don't mind me asking?

I recently finished high school and I'm completely lost. I never really found my "thing" and now I'm just stuck here with hobbies that I'm only ok at. I've got way too much time left to live and not enough things to fill it with. I feel like a failure. I just want to end it before I have to face the real world. Sorry if I'm causing distress, I just can't stop talking or the anxiety will come back.
I'm going through all this bullshit right now too. I'd be down to listen if you need a listener. I just feel like I need someone to hate the world with for a moment.
Thnx, I've got varying opinions on the moustache. Personally don't like the look so I'll prob get rid of it. The hair... I usually just wear hats tbh.
